quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #9
										  					
  

20 Questions • Passing Score 15

questions.question: How do you enter a freeway?

options.text: Signal, let other traffic go first, and enter at the same speed as traffic.
Signal and enter. Freeway traffic must let you in.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal, let other traffic go first, and enter at the same speed as traffic.
questions.explanation: Signal and enter at the same speed as other traffic. Always let existing traffic go first when entering a roadway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: At an uncontrolled intersection, if you arrive at the same time as vehicles on your right and left, what should you do?

options.text: Let the vehicle on your left go first.
Let the vehicle on your right go first.
Wait until no vehicles are at the intersection before going.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let the vehicle on your right go first.
questions.explanation: At an intersection with no signs or signals, the vehicle on your right has the right-of-way. Other drivers should go in the order they arrived.

questions.question: Drivers do not have to yield to pedestrians who cross against the traffic light.
questions.explanation: You must always let pedestrians go first. Pedestrians may sometimes cross against the light by mistake.

questions.question: What does an orange sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs show construction, maintenance, and emergency work ahead.

questions.question: Only vehicles with disability plates or placards can park in reserved disability spaces.
questions.explanation: Disability parking spaces can only be used by vehicles with disability license plates, Disabled Veteran plates, or disabled parking placards.

questions.question: It starts to rain while you are driving. What should you do?

options.text: Drive at the highest posted speed limit.
Drive close behind the vehicle in front of you.

questions.explanation: Slow down when rain makes it hard to see. Turn on your headlights so others can see you. If rain is very heavy, pull to the shoulder and stop until it clears.

questions.question: When can you cross double yellow lines to pass another vehicle?

options.text: When the vehicle in front moves right to let you pass.
When the yellow line on your side is broken.
When the yellow line on the opposite side is broken.

questions.correctAnswerText: When the yellow line on your side is broken.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line means traffic on that side can pass if it is safe to do so.

questions.question: When must you stop for a school bus?

options.text: When it is parked on the shoulder with no one in it.
When it approaches you, even without flashing lights.
When you are on a two-lane road and its red lights are flashing.
Whenever the driver waves at you.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you are on a two-lane road and its red lights are flashing.
questions.explanation: Stop when a school bus has flashing red lights while picking up or dropping off children. On a two-lane road, traffic from both directions must stop when red lights flash or the stop arm extends.

questions.question: If a driver is worried, nervous, angry, or upset, they should:

options.text: Drive normally since emotions do not affect driving.
Drive faster because they are more alert.
Calm down and focus before starting the car.
Call a friend to talk while driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Calm down and focus before starting the car.
questions.explanation: Strong emotions can distract you from driving safely. Calm down and focus on the road before you start driving.

questions.question: If a vehicle skids on water, the driver should quickly apply the brakes.
questions.explanation: When a vehicle hydroplanes, do not use the brakes. Instead, try to regain control. If you cannot, release the accelerator and let the skid stop on its own.

questions.question: If a truck or bus is turning right where you also need to turn right, you should:

options.text: Quickly turn before the truck or bus.
Wait until the truck or bus finishes turning before you turn.
Squeeze between the truck or bus and the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until the truck or bus finishes turning before you turn.
questions.explanation: Do not try to fit your vehicle between a turning truck or bus and the curb. This can cause a serious crash. Wait until the truck or bus completes its turn before you turn.

questions.question: When may you pass on the right shoulder of the road?

options.text: When the car in front is driving too slowly.
When the car in front is turning.

questions.explanation: Never drive off the pavement or onto the shoulder to pass another vehicle. You may only pass when it is legal and safe to do so.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: When driving on snow or ice:

options.text: It is safe to use cruise control.
Change your speed and direction slowly and gently.
Drive the same way you would in normal conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change your speed and direction slowly and gently.
questions.explanation: On snow or ice, make all speed and direction changes slowly and gently. Never use cruise control on snow or ice because your tires may lose grip and you could lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: Orange signs are:
questions.explanation: Work zone signs are orange and diamond-shaped with black letters or symbols. They warn you that people are working on or near the highway.

questions.question: Passing is not allowed:
questions.explanation: You cannot pass on hills, curves, at intersections, or at railroad crossings. Passing in these places is both illegal and unsafe.

questions.question: Driving while distracted:

options.text: Usually causes the driver to react slower to hazards.
Usually causes the driver to drive faster.
Is only dangerous for young drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Usually causes the driver to react slower to hazards.
questions.explanation: Distraction makes drivers slow to react to traffic and hazards. Distracted driving is never safe.

questions.question: When passing other vehicles:

options.text: Check your mirrors and blind spots.
Honk your horn at least three times.
Return to your lane within 10 feet of the passed vehicle.
There is no need to signal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your mirrors and blind spots.
questions.explanation: Before passing, check your mirrors and blind spots. Use your turn signal before changing lanes. Return to your lane when you can see the front of the other vehicle in your rearview mirror.

questions.question: Traffic moving in opposite directions is divided by ____ lines.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines divide traffic moving in opposite directions.
